review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one definition, `baseChangeFrobenius`, and a few lemmas. The definition is `(frobeniusIsogeny W).map (algebraMap F K)`. This is a deliberately named specialisation of the library's own `Isogeny.map`, and the docstring explains why the name is useful. The lemma `baseChangeFrobenius_def` is `rfl` and is presented as an API convenience. It is a theorem-level wrapper, which is outside this rubric. Isogenies and Frobenius isogenies of Weierstrass curves are not in Mathlib, Batteries or core, so I found no competing Mathlib concept. I did not search Mathlib for a generic Frobenius-twist or base-change notion that might overlap. I found no evidence of duplicated API or repeated conversions that would justify consolidation.
